shared: Production background artwork only for QVANIX mobile investment terminal. Portrait 9:16. No UI, no text, no logos, no numbers, no charts, no typography. Premium cinematic realism, rich material detail, atmospheric depth. Critical mobile composition: reserve the upper-left and lower-left as quiet low-detail zones for financial UI; place the recognizable hero subject in the center-right, fully visible from head to feet where applicable, never cropped by the right edge. Strong visual identity at first glance.

themes.samurai: Japanese mountain world at saturated crimson and burnt-orange sunset. One large detailed lone samurai in layered armor, full body, centered around 62% of image width and 42% height, clearly visible silhouette, giant glowing sun behind but not obscuring him, distant pagoda and layered mountains, red maple branches framing edges. Calm disciplined stance, no battle, weapon not emphasized. Left third quieter/darker for portfolio data.
themes.cosmos: Deep cobalt and indigo planetary expedition. Large suited explorer seated or standing center-right with a clearly visible small dog companion, huge blue planet horizon, distant spacecraft and nebula, cyan rim light, sophisticated cinematic realism. Keep both explorer and dog completely inside frame. Left third quieter for portfolio data.
themes.neon: Premium near-future megacity at blue hour, magenta-violet and electric cyan towers, elevated balcony and distant flying transit. One understated urban explorer center-right seen from behind, clearly visible but secondary to the city. Deep perspective, rain-polished glass, elegant rather than cyberpunk clutter. Quiet darker left third for data.
themes.zen: Warm Japanese zen mountain retreat in morning sun: sculptural pine, waterfall, misty dramatic peaks, timber terrace, stone garden and a small calm cat on the right. Ivory, warm wood and restrained emerald green. No futuristic technology. Distinct organic sanctuary, spacious quiet left third for data.
themes.nord: Premium cinematic Scandinavian mythic fjord world. A lone Viking warrior in dark fur and weathered black leather stands on a snowy cliff in the right third with one large grey wolf beside him, both looking across a deep Norwegian fjord toward a distant illuminated Nordic city and several longships. Vast snow mountains, cold mist, dramatic clouds and restrained green-teal aurora. Main palette deep navy, steel blue, icy cyan, snow white and charcoal; warm amber only as restrained accents in city windows, ship lanterns, fires and water reflections. Quiet strength, discipline and long-horizon mood. Realistic fur, wet rock, snow, dark metal and subtle carved-stone detail. Keep generous quiet upper-left and center-left safe zones for app UI; no smartphone, no UI, no text, no logos, no fantasy clutter.
themes.imperium: Sunlit monumental contemporary-classical financial city: warm ivory stone, brushed gold details, soaring arches and modern skyline, a restrained white stone lion sculpture center-right, water reflections and long morning shadows. Luxurious but tasteful, no fantasy palace excess. Quiet warm left third for data.
